keyword_evidence: Marketplace and retail SERPs support Celtic Tree of Life rugs, Yggdrasil rugs, Tree of Life doormats, Celtic knot rugs, personalized teacher classroom rugs and composition notebook classroom rugs. B041 separates near-neighbor products by visible artwork: blue-purple Celtic landscape tree, cream line-art tree, green-gold welcome mat, black floral tree tapestry, purple celestial moon tree, teal Yggdrasil roots, black-and-cream Celtic border, black composition notebook frog rug, pastel teacher-name rug and black speckled welcome-to-classroom rug.
buyer_summary: B041 buyers include Celtic decor shoppers, Tree of Life and Yggdrasil fans, nature/spiritual home decor buyers, housewarming gift buyers, teachers decorating preschool or elementary classrooms and parents buying personalized teacher gifts.
purchase_concerns: Whether the motif matches the intended decor or classroom theme, whether personalization is represented accurately, size fit, softness, non-slip backing, washability or cleaning needs, color brightness, and whether broad generic rug language overstates unsupported features.
